close_reason: Added deny.toml at workspace root with [advisories]/[licenses]/[bans]/[sources] sections. cargo deny check reports all four checks ok. Also added version='0.1' to every workspace.dependency sibling reference (was path-only, which fails cargo publish) — JMAP-sc1b.23 partially addressed. JMAP-hge6 (CI cargo-deny job) is now unblocked.
description:
There is no top-level deny.toml. For a 25-crate workspace targeting crates.io, this means license / advisory / duplicate-version / source policy is unenforced.

Recommended sections:
- [advisories]: Use RustSec advisory db; vulnerability = deny, unmaintained = warn
- [licenses]: allow MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, Unicode-DFS-2016, Zlib (typical RustCrypto profile); deny anything that didn't make the allow-list
- [bans]: deny multiple-versions for shared deps where reasonable
- [sources]: allow crates.io only

Once added, wire `cargo deny check` into CI (depends on JMAP-sc1b.X for CI setup).
title: P2: No cargo-deny configuration (deny.toml absent)
